title: BSI: One view of the sales pipeline | enCloud9
meta: How enCloud9 implemented Dynamics 365 Sales for Biometric Signature ID with custom process flows and real-time dashboards, from first lead to close.
h1: One view from lead to close
answer: Biometric Signature ID (BSI) is a biometric security software company in Lewisville, TX. It needed one system to track and improve its whole sales process, from first lead to closed deal. We implemented Microsoft Dynamics 365 with custom business process flows and real-time dashboards. BSI now has better pipeline management and less manual effort.
facts: No integrated system to track the sales process from lead to close
outcomes: Management has real-time insight into sales activities.
chapters: Biometric Signature ID (BSI) builds software tools for security and serves sectors such as education and finance. It is an emerging startup and a Microsoft partner with over 15 years in biometric security.
BSI needed a way to track and improve its entire sales process, from initial lead generation to closing opportunities, and chose us to implement Microsoft Dynamics 365.
We built customized business process flows in Dynamics 365.
We also built dashboards that give BSI's management team real-time insight into sales activities.
Lead management and opportunity tracking are simpler. BSI has better sales pipeline management, less manual effort, and higher overall sales efficiency.
author: Kristin Caniglia
